properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 29 at 10:11AM CDT until August 30 at 9:10AM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Illinois...Indiana...

Wabash River at Vincennes

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in
Illinois...Indiana...

Wabash River at Hutsonville Legacy Power Plant Site

Wabash River at Riverton

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River from Hutsonville down
to Vincennes. The river has crested. Flooding should come to an end
on the Wabash over the weekend.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Vincennes.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 17.0 feet, Considerable agricultural flooding extends
from just north of the junction of Illinois 33 with Business 50 to
the St. Francesville, Illinois area.  River Road from Lincoln
Memorial Bridge to Billett Rd is impassable.  Extensive seep water
forms behind Illinois levees extending from Russellville to U.S.
Highway 50.  Flooding of agricultural land begins in Knox County
Indiana west of the railroad extending for the Oaktown area to the
north side of Vincennes.  Extensive flooding of Small Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:45 AM CDT /10:45 AM EDT/ Saturday the stage was 17.1 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:45 AM CDT /10:45 AM EDT/ Saturday was 18.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage late
this evening and continue falling to 4.4 feet Tuesday, September
08.
- Flood stage is 16.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1015 PM CDT /1115
PM EDT/.

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 29 at 2:25PM EDT until August 29 at 5:30PM EDT by NWS Raleigh NC
properties.description:
FFWRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Sampson County in central North Carolina...

* Until 530 PM EDT.

* At 225 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Clinton, Turkey and Hobbton.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

properties.areaDesc: Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out 20 NM
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 29 at 2:30PM EDT until August 29 at 3:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
properties.description:
SMWMFL

The National Weather Service in Miami has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Chokoloskee to Bonita Beach FL out 20 NM...

* Until 300 PM EDT.

* At 230 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm capable of producing
waterspouts was located near Naples, moving north at 15 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to nearly 50 knots.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Naples, Vanderbilt Beach, and Bonita Shores.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with this storm. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or the National Weather
Service. You can also share your report with NWS Miami on Facebook
and Twitter.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 29 at 11:52AM MST until August 29 at 12:15PM MST by NWS Flagstaff AZ
properties.description:
SVRFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Yavapai County in west central Arizona...

* Until 1215 PM MST.

* At 1152 AM MST, a severe thunderstorm was located near Yava in
rural areas of Yavapai County, moving north at 25 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and quarter size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Hail damage to vehicles is expected. Expect wind damage to
roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Yava and rural areas of Yavapai County.

This includes State Route 96 between mile markers 14 and 21.
properties.instruction:
Seek shelter inside a well-built structure and stay away from
windows. This storm is capable of producing damaging winds and large
hail.

Torrential rainfall is also occurring with this storm and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.
